issues.reason: Financial history FY2014–2020 is legacy FGC; FY2022–2023 is enlarged Rosseti. These are separate metrics/series; do not calculate growth across perimeters. FY2021 financial gap. No verified FY2024–2026 data yet.
Legacy operating series are ENES of FGC, while 2021–2023 are group grids. Input minus output can differ from reported losses by 1 million kWh due to rounding. Plans for 2023/2024 excluded.

Cash CAPEX is PPE and intangible purchases, not investment-programme financing with VAT. Legacy CFO excludes financing-classified interest; enlarged-group CFO includes paid interest. CFO-minus-CAPEX is labelled, not claimed comparable company FCF.

Financial expenses are not pure interest. Company net debt can include financial assets; mechanical borrowings-minus-cash remains separate. Company EBITDA excludes impairment, unlike plain IFRS operating profit.

Static public JSON literals parsed without executing source code. Main-site certificate failure not bypassed; several older archive TLS errors and 2019 PDF 50MiB cap recorded. SKRIN archive returned no issuer documents. Publication dates unknown; no LTM or daily multiples.
